svg.text: Pick & Place - Raspberry Pi 5 + BTT Octopus V1.1: wiring
Pi = display, touch, joystick, vacuum sensor, cameras, website, jobs. Octopus = all motors, Z flag, E-stop, MOSFET outputs. Same colour = same wire. Pin numbers = physical header pins.
ADS1115, buzzer and the connectors below are on the carrier board ../../board (schematic.png); this sheet shows the same nets as loose wiring.
ADS1115 VDD, BMP280 VCC + CSB, joystick +, touch
not connected (ILI9488 does not release it)
I2C1 address 0x76 (SDO -> GND); sensor inside a small sealed box on the vacuum hose
powered from 3.3 V: centre = 1.65 V = ~13200 counts (joy_*_center)
3V3 pin 1 (NOT 5 V: ADS1115 inputs max VDD)
MMBT2222A low-side switch, 1N4148W across a magnetic buzzer
Octopus: leave the USB 5 V power jumper OFF
(MAIN at 12 V: 12 V rail ~1 V low, OK)
TVS SMBJ15A + 100 uF at the Octopus input
Pi 5: own 5 V / 5 A supply on USB-C
(27 W supply or 12 V -> 5.1 V buck module)
Carrier board: 5 V + 3.3 V from the Pi
Pump / valve / top light: FAN5 / HE1 / FAN0,
BTT Octopus V1.1 (STM32F407ZET6, 8 x TMC2209 in UART mode) - own firmware ../../octopus-fw
All driver slots: UART jumper fitted (no MS jumpers). DIAG jumpers on slots 0, 1, 6 and 7 (sensorless X both sides, gantry, Y), nowhere else.
Inputs (endstop connectors: only the Z flag and the E-stop are switches)
DIAG0 X side 1 StallGuard (jumper, nothing plugged in)
DIAG1 X side 2 StallGuard (jumper, nothing plugged in)
DIAG4 feeder sensor (triggers at each feeder centre)
DIAG5 E-STOP button (NO to GND; NC button: SET in_invert_5 1)
DIAG7 Y StallGuard (jumper, nothing plugged in)
TFT header: tool changer board, RX pin 2 (PA10), GND pin 4, 5 V pin 5
slot sensors as one byte, 9600 baud; pin by pin: octopus-wiring.png
Load cell HX711 on EXP1: DT = pin 3 (PE9), SCK = pin 4 (PE10), GND = pin 9
VCC = 3.3 V LDO from EXP1 pin 10 (5 V); RATE pin to VCC (80/s)
FAN5 vacuum pump (12 V, jumper on VIN)
FAN0 top camera light (12 V, always on,
off while the bottom light is on)
